coordinates.note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder) centroid of the LNF research-institute polygon, Via Enrico Fermi 54, Frascati. Campus-grade only: the DAΦNE rings and the KLOE hall are not individually located by any source consulted.

name: INFN Frascati National Laboratories (LNF) campus
notes: Campus point only; no fetched source locates the DAΦNE interaction region or the KLOE hall.

summary.plain: The campus of the Frascati National Laboratories of the Italian National Institute for Nuclear Physics, near Rome, where the DAΦNE electron-positron collider and the KLOE experiment are located.
summary.technical: INFN Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati, Via Enrico Fermi 54, Frascati (Rome). Geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) polygon centroid, about 500 m precision; hosts DAΦNE, its Beam Test Facility and SPARC_LAB.
